senses.gloss: (cmp. רָז) to be strong, hard; [b. h. רזה to be lean].
to come with vehemence upon, stir up, irritate.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 120b:9">Yeb. 120ᵇ</cite> <he>שאני מיא דמַרְזוּ מכה</he> it is different with water (coming in contact with a wound), it irritates the wound.
Snh. 45ᵇ כי היכא דתיתי מר׳ (Ms. M. מִירַזְּיָא Ithpa., ed. Sonc. ברַזְיָא, v. next w.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) in order that the stone may come down with force.
